run_ddpg_training: run the DDPG training loop with a Q agent, action agent, logger, and config
soft_update_params: soft update target network parameters using a tau interpolation factor
state_dict_device: move an agent state dict to a specified device like cpu or cuda
main_entry: run the Hydra main entry point to instantiate agents and start DDPG training
review_run_ddpg: review the run_ddpg function to understand the DDPG training loop and loss computation
